g.text: (wasting — acute) · Head circumference (brain growth) · <−2 SD = malnourished, <−3 SD =
SEVERE. Plot EVERY visit — flat/falling lines alarm before cutoffs do. Length <2 y lying,
height ≥2 y standing; shoes off, Frankfurt gaze, two measurers for squirmers.
TECHNIQUE (wrong measure = wrong child): zeroed/calibrated scale · light clothes ·
same time of day · read eye-level · repeat if odd · MUAC left-arm midpoint, tape flat ·
OEDEMA check both feet (press 3 s — pit = kwashiorkor/SAM until proven, M05!).
ADULT EXTRAS: waist (men >102, women >88 cm = metabolic risk) · weight TREND (5% in
3 mo unintentional = red flag — MUST, GER M06) · grip/strength eyeball · pregnancy: weight
READING RULES: trend beats point (crossing lines down = failing, even "normal") · stunting
= chronic story (feed + infections + care history) · wasting = ACUTE (food now + illness
hunt) · oedema + any MUAC = SAM protocol (M05) · obesity rising: BMI + waist + counsel
(M05) — Ghana's double burden (stunted child, obese mother, same house).
DOCUMENT: date, weight, height, MUAC, oedema Y/N, z-scores, plotted chart filed,
action + review date (PRO-I M5). Calibrate scales monthly; broken tapes replaced —
equipment lies kill quietly. Teach mothers to READ the chart ("line going up = growing
well") — literate mothers return; lectured mothers default.
Exam line: \"measure twice, plot always, read trends — oedema overrules every tape.\"
